Summary: Extends FindLast reduction optimization to sink simple expressions of a widened induction into the scalar epilogue/main-loop split, instead of only handling the raw IV. The pass now detects binary expressions over a widened IV plus loop-invariant operand, clones the expression for scalar use, and rewrites the reduction result to track the underlying IV directly. The change spans LoopVectorize and VPlanTransforms and substantially rewrites the FindIV reduction lowering path.
